mentions.name: FanFlame
mentions.description: This web app provides an interactive map-based search interface for concerts and events in the Bay Area, letting users search and filter by any combination of locations, dates, and genres. It pulls automated data feeds from Ticketmaster and the Civic Joy Fund, with plans to add Parks & Rec, library events, and other ticketing sites as sources.
mentions.problem: Plenty of event aggregators exist, but few let you search and filter by any combination of locations, dates, and genres.
mentions.audience: This is something the author always wanted for themselves as a personal tool, offered publicly for Bay Area event-goers.
